scope: Paired call identities, captured phase ownership, resolvable snapshot backreferences, successful native pointer/keyboard/upload child-frame targets, fixture call sites/source bytes and filmstrip resource/page bindings for the frame-locator fixture.
limitations: Input snapshots can describe attempted input on failed calls; their presence does not prove that browser input occurred. Trusted-input outcomes are checked by the shared fixture.
Trace call/snapshot/input/filmstrip counts and layouts need not match. JPEG headers and resource bindings do not establish rendered visual fidelity or public viewer parity.
